title: Homology of derived open pullback is restricted homology
statement: Let T be a scheme, W an open subset, E an object of D(O_T) [def-pc-derived-category], and n an integer. Choose derived-category localizations of the module-sheaf categories on T and W in the same morphism universe. Then H^n(L(W.ι)^*E) [def-pc-derived-pullback] is isomorphic to ordinary restriction of H^n(E) [def-pc-module-pullback]. No boundedness, flatness, or quasi-coherence hypothesis on E is needed; W may be empty.

source.place: Proof, third paragraph: identify E on the open locus through its cohomology sheaf; first step of lem-pc-derived-pullback-single-cohomology

proof.text: Unpack the specification of the chosen derivedPullback [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Functor extensionality identifies its stated underived functor with tensorPullback. Use [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and Mathlib pullbackPushforwardAdjunction to identify tensorPullback with ordinary pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints; compose with restrictFunctorIsoPullback to identify it with exact open restriction.

Represent E by the localization preimage G. Take a K-flat resolution s:P→G from [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. The chosen derived counit is invertible at P, so the localization and homotopy-quotient comparison isomorphisms identify L(W.ι)^*E with the localization of termwise tensor pullback of P. This uses only the counit clause of [def-pc-derived-pullback], not derived-functor choices for arbitrary witnesses.

Transport exactness from restriction to tensorPullback by the natural isomorphism of step 1. Apply Mathlib mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso and homologyFunctorFactors to identify the degree-n homology with tensorPullback of H^n(P). The quasi-isomorphism P→G and Q(G)≅E identify H^n(P) with H^n(E). Finally apply the degree-n component of the tensorPullback-to-restriction isomorphism. All these are ordinary compositions of isomorphisms and are valid for every integer n, including on the empty open.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_homology_derivedOpenPullback_iso_restrict
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (W : T.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory T) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
        ((derivedPullback W.ι).obj E) ≅
      (restrictFunctor W.ι).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E))
